name: Plaud Ingest Context Budget + Eval Harness Async Subagent Fixes
description: Two capability batches from the 2026-10-28 boot token analysis. (1) Eval harness correctly records async background subagents: per-resume-segment SubagentStart dedup/reopen, stop-origin records for stubs that never existed or were swept mid-run, agent_type fallback restricted to agent_id-less payloads (kills the 10/28 hijack cascade), and close-open-evals never deletes agent stubs. (2) plaud-ingest gets a bounded context budget: context_tools.py broker keeps transcript bodies out of the conversation (speaker-evidence, action-candidates, assemble-note, note-digest), wired into steps 01/03/05 and both Plaud skills, with state counters, two new runtime assertions, and a fallback ladder that never blocks ingestion. Also: step-06 verification is script-first via ingest-reconcile.py (Ralph only on anomaly), and measure.py recursively stringifies mapping keys so unquoted YAML date keys no longer kill measurement snapshots.
